topic: Pick a project management tool for a small startup

scenario.topic: Pick a project management tool for a small startup
scenario.opening_question: What balance of ease of use, cost, and feature depth matters most for our project management?

options.name: Trello Standard Plan
options.upside: Very intuitive interface with strong mobile support
options.tradeoff: Limited automation and fewer integrations compared to competitors
options.concern: May become insufficient as project complexity grows
options.best_for: teams prioritizing ease of use and mobile access

options.name: Asana Premium Plan
options.upside: Robust features including task dependencies and detailed reporting
options.tradeoff: Higher cost may strain the limited budget
options.concern: Steeper learning curve for new users
options.best_for: teams needing advanced task tracking and reporting

options.name: ClickUp Unlimited Plan
options.upside: Highly customizable with unlimited storage and views
options.tradeoff: Interface can feel overwhelming and requires onboarding
options.concern: Potential for feature overload slowing down simple workflows

options.name: Monday.com Basic Plan
options.upside: Good automation with moderate templates and user limit fits team size
options.tradeoff: Basic plan lacks some advanced reporting and integrations
options.concern: Automation limits may be restrictive for fast-growing teams
options.best_for: teams wanting balanced automation with straightforward setup

shared_context: The startup has exactly 4 team members who will use the tool daily
Budget is limited to around $50 per month total
The team needs to manage software development tasks and client communications

personas.name: Pavel
personas.background: As the product lead, I value tools that offer advanced task tracking and reporting to manage complex workflows effectively.
personas.private_goal: I want a project management tool that supports dependencies and detailed reporting to keep our projects on track.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

personas.name: Felix
personas.background: As a developer focused on ease of use and mobile access, I prefer a simple and intuitive tool that doesn't overwhelm the team.
personas.private_goal: I want a cost-effective tool with a strong mobile app that helps us stay organized without complexity.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference

personas.name: Beatriz

personas.private_goal: I want a highly customizable tool with unlimited storage that can scale with our increasing needs.

personas.name: Cleo
personas.background: As the team lead, I value balanced automation and straightforward setup to keep the team efficient without overcomplication.
personas.private_goal: I want a tool with good automation and moderate templates that fits our small team size well.
